purpose: Build the frozen common real-data input for B0, BL, BG, and BN exposure comparisons
company_information: 86 Core-86 cross-sectional ranks, 86 matching missing indicators, and log1p market capitalization

state_information.factor_history: For each of six factors, compounded 1-, 3-, and 12-month returns and 12-month monthly volatility, all ending in feature month t
state_information.market_daily: Feature-month daily realized Mkt-RF volatility and trailing-12-month total-market maximum drawdown
state_information.cross_section: Current-month return dispersion, positive-return breadth, equal-weight return, median three-month daily CAPM idiosyncratic volatility, and value-weighted Core-86 ranks for book-to-market, ROAQ, and asset growth

eligibility: Require complete 12-month state history and at least 15 valid target-month daily stock returns
